method: G4 pooled GBT: E3.2 prep (fuel-corrected race LapTimeS, clean-lap + not-first-of-stint), target = time minus early-stint baseline; one XGBoost across mapped C-codes with compound_id + era categorical and tyre_life, weather, gap-to-nearest, n_corners, stint_position. Slopes are finite differences at tyre_life 2→12.
